caption: The drawing depicts a metallic object with a rectangular base that has ridged sections and a hollow opening on one side. Mounted on the base is a semi-cylindrical component with gear-like edges, featuring embossed letters including the words "AND" and "CUTTER" that are partially visible. The object also has a curved metal handle attached to the top of the semi-cylindrical piece, with a dark, textured grip. The entire item is rendered in shades of brown, gray, and metallic hues, giving it a worn and slightly tarnished appearance. The background is plain and light-toned, and there is a thin border around the edges of the drawing. Some text is also visible in the lower right corner outside the main object.
title: Hand Fluting Iron
